anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc forming a low-profile curve towards the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby projection with high thickness relative to the visible length from the melon crease.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the crease where the melon curvature meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple light-colored, linear rake marks are visible on the mid-lateral flank and dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark pigmented patch surrounding the eye and a high-contrast white tip on the rostrum.
